summary: WhatsApp gaps from Workshop ewatrade/assistant/conversations v2 (revision 378e5ca2), families 16 and 18. (1) The WhatsApp form launcher accepts the phrases the design uses: an optional a/an/new between the verb and the noun and a trailing full stop or ! ("record a sale", "Add a customer.", "add new product", "record an expense!"). Matching stays exact, so "record a sale of bread for 150" still goes to the model. (2) The general prompt now says a customer's "I have paid" report on a payment link is a claim that is confirmed or marked not received in EwaTrade on the payment report, and that the assistant never drafts payment_record or another payment for it. Local only; no Meta Flow, provider, OTP or deployment change.

capabilities.note: Prompt guidance only: payment reports from customers are confirmed in EwaTrade, never in chat, and never become a payment_record draft. The capability's action, roles, clients and rollout are unchanged.

docs.note: 3 Nov gap implementation section lists the form phrases and the payment-report guard.

evidence.result: 4 pass, 31 expects: a/an/new and trailing punctuation launch the form; requests with extra words still return null.
